diagnosis.merged_summary_correction: The pinned logs do not show identical final allocation sites. Job 200123 ends on 896 MiB, while the warm-cache retry ends on a 3 GiB FlashInfer DeepGEMM output. Both are startup-only failures caused by the 65,536-token dummy run.

execution.order: Submit base, wait for its terminal retained attempt, inspect hourly occupancy, then submit decode.
execution.resume_rule: Never overwrite an attempt. Retain a file manifest for every terminal attempt and park on SSH or MFA loss with the last job identifier and state.

fatal_guards: The model, revision, reduced depth, framework version, CUDA-graph mode and TP1/DP1/EP1 physical envelope match the frozen identity.
The scheduler marker reports one decode step with exactly 32 requests and exactly 2,000 computed KV tokens for every request.
Exactly one execute_context_0(0)_generation_32(32) boundary is selected through Nsight Systems runtime correlations.
The measured service is the positive additive noncollective kernel duration inside that boundary, converted from nanoseconds to integer picoseconds.
No model weight file appears in the isolated cache, and every retained source is digest complete.
The scorer reads the measured service once and does not modify the prediction, tolerance or sign convention.

measurement_contract.service: additive noncollective GPU kernel duration selected by exact NVTX runtime correlation

occupancy.policy: Pace short submissions, keep base and decode sequential, and do not bypass queue occupancy.

startup_amendment.alignment: Calibrate staggered prompt lengths under the small scheduler cap, keep early requests alive, and accept only the first full-batch decode state whose 32 cached token counts are all exactly 2,000.
startup_amendment.measurement_effect: None. The startup profile and prompt-construction route are scaffolding outside the selected decode boundary.
